flashcard_questions.q: Which term means Hippocrates’ theory that the body held blood, yellow bile, black bile and phlegm, which all had to stay balanced?

An Ancient Greek physician (c.460–370 BC) known as the ‘Father of Medicine.’ He rejected supernatural explanations for disease, promoted clinical observation, and developed the Theory of the Four Humours.
The practice of carefully watching and recording a patient’s symptoms over time to identify patterns and predict the course of an illness.

flashcard_questions.a: A collection of around 60 medical texts written by Hippocrates and his followers.
An ethical oath traditionally taken by doctors, attributed to Hippocrates.
